scope: 60 authored Arabic origins, no independent empirical observations; retained readings and unseen-origin neural suggestions scored separately
unit: origin; keep every clause, paraphrase and withdrawal from the origin in the same partition
neural_input: original clause bytes only; no origin, group, split, teacher binding or answer in the features
neural_tasks: predict relation class including independent context
rank contiguous cue spans up to three written terms
head: class-balanced ridge with positive penalty 0.1 on frozen NABT occurrence vectors including intercept; no validation tuning
baseline: training-majority relation, first term cue, first clause focus; record exact cue and family breakdown
gates: report neural errors rather than suppressing them; licensed readings require separate evidence; no promotion to external event; an invalid factorization does not refute parity
test_access: developer-authored diagnostic, fixed before fitting; independent blind review outstanding
